label: German Language
lede: The German you actually meet in Berlin: on signs, in forms, at counters, and in the words nobody translates for you. Enough to get the thing done, not a course.

lead.title: German Courses in Berlin: What a Lesson Costs and Why the Rules Change at B1
lead.excerpt: The same 45 minutes of German teaching in Berlin can legally cost you nothing, 80 cents or 10 euro. Up to B1 the Volkshochschule price is capped by a federal number and nobody gets a discount. Above B1 the cap disappears and the discounts come back. Here is what each route really costs.
